title: Claims status overview
caption: Claim volume, open claims, days to decision and denial rate for one employer account, with the pipeline by status.
story: This page is for an employer's HR team. It answers: how many claims have my employees filed, where are they, and how fast are we deciding?

Row-level security limits every figure to the viewer's own account, so there is no need to filter by hand. The tiles carry a status line, such as how many open claims are over 30 days. The pipeline chart deepens in colour as a claim moves toward payment, and denied claims are red.
The open claims table lists the oldest first, because the oldest claim is the one someone should chase.

title: Claim volume tooltip
caption: The tooltip page behind the claim tiles.
story: A tooltip page. It repeats the volume tiles with a one-line note on what the counts cover, so the definition is one hover away.
